name: Octop
description: Runs a self-hosted, multi-user, multi-agent assistant that reaches people through IM channels and delegates coding tasks to agents over ACP.

skills.name: Personal assistant
skills.description: Writes weekly reports, organizes notes and manages schedules with a dedicated agent per user.

skills.name: Team task routing
skills.description: Routes tasks from Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom and WeChat into teams of agents working in parallel.

skills.name: Delegate coding tasks
skills.description: Delegates coding tasks to OpenCode or Claude Code over ACP, or troubleshoots from the terminal.
